Definition: from G2771; to gain (literally or figuratively):--(get) gain, win.
BiblicalUsage: Kerdaino means to gain, to win: Matthew 16:26 asks, what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul? Luke 9:25 asks the same, for what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself? 1 Corinthians 9:19 says Paul made himself servant unto all, that I might gain the more. Philippians 3:8 says Paul counts all things but loss, that I may win Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe gain is the question every life answers: the world gained and the soul lost, or all things lost and Christ won. I hold that Paul's arithmetic is the only one that adds up, because Christ is worth more than the whole world.
